mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity_id = #{opportunityId} ORDER BY history_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT opportunity.opportunity_id FROM crm_opportunity opportunity JOIN crm_sales_stage stage ON stage.stage_code = opportunity.stage AND stage.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND stage.deleted = 0 WHERE opportunity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND opportunity.deleted = 0 AND opportunity.status = 'OPEN' AND opportunity.opportunity_id > #{afterId} AND opportunity.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND stage.status = 'ACTIVE' AND stage.is_won_flag = 0 AND stage.is_lost_flag = 0 AND stage.overdue_days IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, opportunity.stage_changed_time, #{now}) >= stage.overdue_days * 86400 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity_stage_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = opportunity.tenant_id AND history.opportunity_id = opportunity.opportunity_id AND history.to_stage = opportunity.stage AND history.changed_time = opportunity.stage_changed_time) ORDER BY opportunity.opportunity_id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity SET stage_duration_days = GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, stage_changed_time, #{now})), update_time = update_time WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND stage_changed_time IS NOT NULL AND stage_duration_days != GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, stage_changed_time, #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role_entry.status = '0' AND role_entry.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu grants ON grants.role_id = role_entry.role_id AND grants.tenant_id = role_entry.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = grants.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' AND menu.perms = 'crm:opportunity:list' WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.user_id = #{userId})
SELECT tenant_id FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_sales_stage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_contact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact_id = #{contactId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
